title: Ice Age: Boiling Point Trailer Brings Manny, Sid and Diego Back to Theaters
excerpt:
The sixth main Ice Age film is set for February 5, 2027, ending an 11-year theatrical gap.
Ray Romano, John Leguizamo, Denis Leary and other familiar voices return for a warmer adventure.
body_md:
The prehistoric family is preparing for its first major theatrical adventure in more than a decade. Ice Age: Boiling Point has unveiled its first full trailer ahead of a planned February 5, 2027 cinema release, marking the sixth main installment in the animated franchise.

The new film arrives eleven years after the last mainline theatrical entry. Although the characters returned in the Disney+ spin-off The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild, the series has not had a comparable big-screen release during that period. This is also the first principal Ice Age feature made after the closure of Blue Sky Studios, with the franchise now under 20th Century Animation and Disney.

John C. Donkin, who directed the Buck Wild spin-off, is directing the new movie, with longtime franchise producer Lori Forte returning. The story follows Manny and his extended family as their icy world continues to warm, sending the group toward unfamiliar environments and fresh challenges.

Much of the recognizable voice cast is back. Ray Romano returns as Manny, John Leguizamo as Sid, Denis Leary as Diego, Queen Latifah as Ellie and Simon Pegg as Buck. Josh Peck reprises Eddie, Chris Wedge returns as Scrat and Adam DeVine voices Julian.

The cast also includes Coco Jones as Peaches, Ashley Park as Zee, Vincent Tong as Crash, Kari Wahlgren as Baby Scrat, Dee Bradley Baker as Jurassic Scrat, Eduardo Franco as Body and James Austin Johnson as Clarence the Sprout Master. Several of these roles represent new additions or recast characters.

The trailer confirms the franchise's return and offers an initial sense of the new setting, but whether this installment can recapture the appeal of the original films will become clearer when audiences see the finished movie. The announced release date remains subject to any subsequent distributor changes.
